release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.12 further strengthens the postflop CPU BOT. Flush and straight draws are now attributed to each actual hole-card combo instead of the public board texture alone, nut and dominated flush draws receive different quality weights, and backdoor flush equity requires a suited hole card. Raise candidate increments now use the post-call pot as the denominator, matching the response model's sizing fraction. The immutable 174-situation preflop policy remains unchanged.
